boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe ways to spend time around Pitt without buying admission or making a purchase; museum access has Pitt-ID and academic-term conditions where noted.

cards.title: See the glasshouse gardens
cards.subtitle: Phipps Conservatory and Botanical Gardens · Schenley Park
cards.notes: Bring a valid Pittsburgh Campus Student ID during the fall or spring term, then take a self-paced look through Phipps’ indoor garden spaces.
cards.short_summary: A Pitt-ID museum visit for a plant-filled change of scene near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt Arts states that Pittsburgh-campus students with a valid Pitt ID receive free admission to Phipps during its fall and spring Free Museum Visits program.
cards.source_title: Free Museum Visits | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Free Museum Visits are for Pittsburgh-campus undergraduate, graduate, and professional students with a valid Pitt ID; the program is suspended in summer and resumes in late August.

cards.title: Walk through local military history
cards.subtitle: Soldiers & Sailors Memorial Hall & Museum · Fifth Avenue
cards.notes: Use your valid Pittsburgh Campus Student ID during the program term and explore the museum exhibits at your own pace before heading back to campus.
cards.short_summary: A student-ID museum visit in the landmark memorial building beside Pitt.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt Arts lists Soldiers & Sailors Memorial Hall & Museum as a Free Museum Visits partner and says Pitt students gain free admission with a valid Pittsburgh Campus Student ID.
cards.source_title: Free Museum Visits | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Free Museum Visits are for Pittsburgh-campus undergraduate, graduate, and professional students with a valid Pitt ID; the program is suspended in summer and resumes in late August.

cards.title: Browse Warhol’s work
cards.subtitle: The Andy Warhol Museum · North Shore
cards.notes: Take your valid Pittsburgh Campus Student ID and plan a self-guided museum visit during the fall or spring Free Museum Visits period.
cards.short_summary: A Pitt-ID route to Warhol’s museum collection across the river from downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt Arts states that Pittsburgh-campus students presenting valid Pitt ID receive free general admission to The Andy Warhol Museum through Free Museum Visits.
cards.source_title: Free Museum Visits | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Free Museum Visits are for Pittsburgh-campus undergraduate, graduate, and professional students with a valid Pitt ID; the program is suspended in summer and resumes in late August.

cards.title: Spend an afternoon with the galleries
cards.subtitle: Carnegie Museum of Art · Forbes Avenue
cards.notes: Reserve the student-rate timed ticket using the Pitt Arts instructions, then present a valid Pittsburgh Campus Student ID when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A nearby art-museum outing available through Pitt Arts’ student access program.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt Arts says Pittsburgh-campus students can obtain a no-charge ticket to Carnegie Museum of Art by selecting the student rate, entering code PITTSTUDENT, and presenting valid Pitt ID.
cards.source_title: Free Museum Visits | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Free Museum Visits are for Pittsburgh-campus undergraduate, graduate, and professional students with a valid Pitt ID; the program is suspended in summer and resumes in late August.

cards.title: Explore the natural-history halls
cards.subtitle: Carnegie Museum of Natural History · Forbes Avenue
cards.notes: Follow Pitt Arts’ timed-ticket instructions, bring your valid Pittsburgh Campus Student ID, and make room for a self-guided museum wander.
cards.short_summary: A Pitt-ID visit to the natural-history museum next to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt Arts says a Carnegie Museum of Natural History student-rate ticket becomes no-charge with code PITTSTUDENT, with valid Pittsburgh Campus Student ID required at entry.
cards.source_title: Free Museum Visits | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Free Museum Visits are for Pittsburgh-campus undergraduate, graduate, and professional students with a valid Pitt ID; the program is suspended in summer and resumes in late August.

cards.title: Make a science-center visit
cards.subtitle: Carnegie Science Center · North Shore
cards.notes: Call the visitor-service line to reserve a timed entry, then show a valid Pittsburgh Campus Student ID at arrival for the student program.
cards.short_summary: A timed, Pitt-ID museum outing focused on hands-on science exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt Arts states that Pittsburgh-campus students may reserve timed Carnegie Science Center entry by phone and gain free admission by presenting valid Pitt ID.
cards.source_title: Free Museum Visits | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Free Museum Visits are for Pittsburgh-campus undergraduate, graduate, and professional students with a valid Pitt ID; the program is suspended in summer and resumes in late August.

cards.title: See installation art in the North Side
cards.subtitle: Mattress Factory · North Side
cards.notes: Bring your valid Pitt ID during the fall or spring term and confirm the venue’s current admissions procedures before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Pitt Arts partner visit for contemporary, room-scale installations.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt Arts identifies the Mattress Factory as one of its Free Museum Visits partners for Pittsburgh-campus students with valid Pitt ID.
cards.source_title: Pitt Arts Frequently Asked Questions | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Free Museum Visits are for Pittsburgh-campus undergraduate, graduate, and professional students with a valid Pitt ID; the program is suspended in summer and resumes in late August.

cards.title: Dig into Western Pennsylvania stories
cards.subtitle: Senator John Heinz History Center · Strip District
cards.notes: Use your valid Pitt ID during the fall or spring program period, and check the museum’s own visitor guidance before leaving Oakland.
cards.short_summary: A Pitt Arts partner visit centered on regional history and collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt Arts identifies the Senator John Heinz History Center as a Free Museum Visits partner for Pittsburgh-campus students with valid Pitt ID.
cards.source_title: Pitt Arts Frequently Asked Questions | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Free Museum Visits are for Pittsburgh-campus undergraduate, graduate, and professional students with a valid Pitt ID; the program is suspended in summer and resumes in late August.

cards.title: Catch a free outdoor movie
cards.subtitle: Flagstaff Hill · Schenley Park
cards.notes: Check the seasonal park schedule, bring a blanket or a seat, and watch a summer film outdoors with friends without buying admission.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal outdoor-movie spot in Schenley Park near the Pittsburgh campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt’s campus tour states that free movies are shown during the summer on Schenley Park’s Flagstaff Hill.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal programming; verify the current movie schedule and weather status before going.

cards.title: Take a trail walk in Schenley Park
cards.subtitle: Panther Hollow Trail · Schenley Park beside campus
cards.notes: Start from the Schenley Park entrance near the visitor center and take a daylight walk along the wooded trails and Panther Hollow Lake.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission outdoor walk a short distance from the Cathedral of Learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt identifies Schenley Park’s scenic trails and Panther Hollow Lake as a five-minute walk from the Cathedral of Learning; the City describes the park as a public place of free open-air recreation.
cards.source_title: Hike, bike and paddle your way through Pitt’s scenic backyard | University of Pittsburgh
cards.access_notes: Use established paths in daylight and check conditions before setting out; no admission is required for the public park trail walk.

warnings: Pitt Arts Free Museum Visits are limited to eligible Pittsburgh-campus students with valid Pitt ID and are suspended in summer; confirm partner procedures before visiting.
